name: expense-api

dependencies.name: aws-s3
dependencies.description: Issues short-lived upload and view links for bill files kept with expenses.

dependencies.name: currency-service
dependencies.description: Looks up exchange rates to LKR, cached per currency and day, so totals, reports and budgets are in LKR.

description: The one backend for the household: members, categories, expenses, bill upload links, budgets and the monthly report, all stored in its own Postgres database. It converts every amount to LKR with cached exchange rates. It is one service because every capability shares the same records and the same two users. It does not read bills (the agent does) and never receives file bytes.
